method_note: FAST MODE. Platform facts from each platform's own official pages only, read live 26 Nov 2026. Prices verbatim in original currency. Brand facts from live weddedwonderland.com only.

facts.claim: Paperless Post pay-per-event pricing uses Coins: multiply the design's Coin cost by the number of recipients. Paperless Post Plus (200 Coins) unlocks extra customisation and guest management tools. Sample calculator shows 3 Coins = $1.44 (USD).
facts.quote: Choose our flexible pay per event plan, where you can add design elements and management features a la carte. Multiply your invitation's Coin cost by the number of recipients for your total send cost. ... Paperless Post Plus 200 coins Unlock more of our customization and guest management tools when you add any Plus feature during the creation process. Great for professional events, weddings, and more. ... Total Coins to send 3 Coins $1.44
facts.use_note: USD (US$ implied; page shows $ with no currency label; US company). Page also carries a time-limited promo (20% off Coins, code ends 12/1); do not quote the promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post says it also has many free designs; a Paperless Pro subscription is priced by annual guest count, shown at $250/year for 250 annual guests (USD).
facts.quote: Paperless Post also has many free invitations and greeting card designs for you to customize and send. ... Try the Paperless Pro subscription, which includes unlimited access to all our features and simple, transparent pricing (no Coins). Plans are based on annual guest count ... Annual guests 250 ... $250/year
facts.use_note: Subscription is pitched at professionals and 3+ events a year; not the obvious pick for one wedding.

facts.claim: Greenvelope sends digital invitations and cards with an animated envelope, liner, stamp and music, by email or text (in supported countries), with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management; guests need no account; flat one-time price by guest count from $19 (USD), no subscription; ad-free.
facts.quote: Greenvelope digital invitations arrive with a signature animated envelope opening, a personalized liner, a stamp, and background music that sets the tone before guests read a word. Upload your own design or customize a designer suite, then send by email or text message (in supported countries) with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management. Guests never need an account to reply. Pricing is a flat one-time amount set by guest count, starting at $19, with no subscription required.
facts.use_note: Currency shown as $ with no label; treat as USD. Text delivery is 'in supported countries': whether Australia is supported is unclear.

facts.claim: Canva plans: Free US$0/month for one person; Pro US$18/month for one person (page shows a time-limited 50% off first 3 months). Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.quote: Free ... US$0 /month for one person ... Pro ... US$18 ... /month for one person ... Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl may have served the US price; Canva shows local currency by region, so AUD pricing for Australians is unclear. Do not quote the 50% promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post save the dates can be customised and shared by email, text or link; it says opens can be tracked; text (SMS) delivery is for US phone numbers only.
facts.quote: Set the tone for a seaside celebration with beach-themed save the dates. Customize and share via email, text, or link. ... Send all of our invitations and cards via text, Shareable Link, and email, too. \* SMS delivery available for US phone numbers only. [meta description:] Browse free and paid beach and tropical save the date card templates. Customize designs. Send ecards via email, text, or link. Track opens.
facts.publisher: Paperless Post (official save the dates category page)
facts.use_note: For Australian guests: SMS is US numbers only, so use email or the Shareable Link (which can be pasted into any message app). 'Track opens' appears in the page meta description, not body copy.

facts.claim: Greenvelope digital wedding save the dates: animated envelope with liner, stamp and music; send by email, text or sharable link; no guest account; address collection inside the save the date; add your wedding website link; tracks opens and responses in real time; upload your own design; daily open-rate summaries.
facts.quote: Send by email, text, or sharable link, ad-free with no guest account required and a flat one-time price by guest count. ... Address Collection Collect guest mailing addresses directly through your save the date for sending paper invitations or thank you notes. ... Your Own Design Have a more specific vision? Upload your own design and still take advantage of Greenvelope's delivery and tracking. ... Add your wedding website link, then send by email, text message, or sharable link. Greenvelope tracks opens and responses in real time and can collect mailing addresses for the invitations that follow. ... Greenvelope pairs with any wedding website builder.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Ignore the page's own '4.9 stars Trustpilot' and 'best way' marketing claims; do not repeat them.

facts.claim: Greenvelope single mailing prices (USD, as listed): up to 20 people $19; up to 100 $99; up to 150 not a tier (up to 160 $159); up to 200 $199; up to 250 $249. Unlimited mailings for a year: up to 150 people per mailing $225/year; up to 250 $375/year. Each person on the list counts as one (a family of four counts as four).
facts.quote: One mailing $19 one time Up to 20 people ... Up to 100 People$99 ... Up to 160 People$159 ... Up to 200 People$199 ... Up to 250 People$249 ... Up to 150 People / Mailing$225 / Year ... Up to 250 People / Mailing$375 / Year ... Each person (with or without email) added to the mailing list counts as (1) person. For example, "The Smith Family" of John, Jill, Tim, and Lauren would count as (4) people.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: $ unlabelled; US company, treat as USD and say so. Prices as read 26 Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Greenvelope text delivery: every paid account includes a maximum of 500 text messages; SMS is 'in supported countries'; also WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger or sharable link.
facts.quote: Every paid Greenvelope account includes a maximum of 500 text messages. ... In addition to email, you can send your Greenvelope invitations and cards via SMS text message (in supported countries), WhatsApp, Facebook messenger, or a sharable link.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Whether Australian mobile numbers are a supported SMS country is unclear from this page.

facts.claim: Greenvelope's own timing line: most couples send save the dates 6 to 8 months before, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding.
facts.quote: Most couples send wedding save the dates 6 to 8 months before the wedding, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding so guests can book travel.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion, not ours. Use our own timing (see WW facts) as the article's guidance; this is a cross-check only.

facts.claim: Evite offers customisable digital wedding save the dates, RSVP optional, in Free and Premium designs, including upload-your-own-design; send by email, text or shareable link; track RSVPs in real time and manage the guest list.
facts.quote: Browse Evite's collection of customizable (and RSVP optional) digital Save the Dates. ... Price Free Premium ... Upload Your Own Design (Portrait) ... we put together ... with Evite, you can send your invites by email, text or shareable link, making it easier to get the word out. You can also track RSVPs in real-time and manage your guest list all from one place
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: No prices on this page. Evite Pro is described as an annual subscription for unlimited Premium invites; cost not stated here (unclear). Whether text works for Australian numbers is not stated (unclear).

facts.claim: Evite Pro is an annual subscription that allows unlimited Premium invites; page meta says you can share instantly for free.
facts.quote: Evite Pro is also a great option for anyone sending lots of invitations throughout the year. This annual subscription allows you to send an unlimited number of Premium invites! [meta description:] Customize your digital design, share instantly for free, and keep guests informed before your big day.
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: 'Free' applies to Free designs; Premium design pricing not shown on this page (unclear).

facts.claim: Evite's own timing line: couples generally send save the dates 8 to 12 months before, and even earlier for destination weddings.
facts.quote: Generally, couples send out these invitations between eight and 12 months before the wedding date. However, you should send out save the date invitations even further in advance for destination weddings or holiday weddings
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion; cross-check only. Note Evite's blog says 6 to 8 months (map snippet), so Evite is internally inconsistent.

facts.claim: Canva has free customisable save the date card templates (2,540 shown) and printed save the date cards from $9.50; it suggests sending earlier for a destination wedding.
facts.quote: Amp up the excitement for your wedding day using free, printable save the date card templates from Canva. ... Showing 50 of 2,540 ... Printable save the date cards by Canva Print from $9.50 ... If you're planning a destination wedding, consider sending it out earlier to give your guests enough time to plan.
facts.publisher: Canva (official save the date templates page)
facts.use_note: Canva is a design tool, not a send-and-track platform: this page names no email delivery, RSVP or open tracking (unclear / not offered here). Position it as 'design it, then send the image or link yourself'. $9.50 currency unlabelled (likely USD from US-served scrape).

facts.claim: Zola digital save the dates (example design 'Coastal' listed as Free): add a photo, customise background colour, collect guests' addresses, link to your wedding website; Zola creates a unique link you paste into a text, email or DM; editable after publishing; matching paper and magnet versions offered.
facts.quote: Coastal Free ... Details - Add a photo - Customize the background color - Collect guests' addresses - Link to your wedding website ... How It Works 1. Customize a digital design. 2. We'll create a unique link to access your digital save the date. 3. Copy and paste this link into a message - send through text, email, or DM! 4. Go hybrid! Some couples like to follow up with matching paper save the dates. ... you can always edit your save the date after it's published.
facts.publisher: Zola (official digital save the date product page)
facts.use_note: Delivery is link-based (you send it yourself), so no Zola-sent email is stated here; open tracking not mentioned (unclear). 'Free' shown on this design; do not claim every Zola digital design is free.

facts.claim: The Knot digital save the dates are described as completely free, fully customisable, and sent as a shareable link by email or text; they can be paired with matching paper invitations and a free wedding website.
facts.quote: On The Knot, these designs are completely free, fully customizable, and a shareable link can be sent instantly to your loved ones via email or text. ... you can pair our electronic designs with matching paper invitations and a free wedding website.
facts.publisher: The Knot (official digital save the date cards page)
facts.use_note: Page lists 86 designs incl. a 'Destination' style. Ignore the CYBER50 paper promo. Open tracking not mentioned (unclear).

facts.claim: The Knot help centre: once digital save the dates are ready you go to the Share section, copy the link and share it.
facts.quote: Once your Digital Save the Dates are ready, you'll be taken to the Share section, shown below - Just copy the link and share it with your friends and family – it's that simple!
facts.use_note: Confirms link-share model; The Knot does not state it emails guests for you on this page. Help article 'Do you offer digital Save the Dates?' answers 'Absolutely!' (updated 2/2/2026).

facts.claim: Joy's pricing page says Joy is free to use ($0/mo), including wedding website, online RSVP, unlimited guests and hundreds of digital invites; optional paid upgrades include custom domains, text messaging and premium designs for digital and printed stationery.
facts.quote: Joy is free to use. $ 0 /mo ... Wedding Website ... Unlimited Guests ... Online RSVP ... Hundreds of Digital Invites ... We've also added optional upgrades, like custom domain names, text messaging, and premium designs for digital and printed stationery
facts.use_note: Upgrade prices not stated on this page (unclear). Firecrawl served a cached copy from 26 Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Joy Basic Digital save the dates are free; Premium Digital Cards are available in Australia among other countries. Cards can show a website link and up to two button links (e.g. RSVP or Travel page); emails can include an Add to Calendar link. Send by copy link (text, WhatsApp, social) or Joy emails personalised cards and you can track who opened them in the guest list.
facts.quote: (Premium Digital Cards are available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and across the EU.) ... Click the Price filter and select Free Digital to see only Basic Digital Cards. ... Toggle Display link to your website on or off ... choose up to two links to display on your card, like your RSVP page or Travel page. ... toggle Include event date and Include "Add to Calendar" link on or off. ... Share with a Link ... Click Copy Link and send it however you like, text message, WhatsApp, social media, group chat. ... Email Personalized Cards means Joy sends personalized emails on your behalf. Each card includes your guest's name, and you can track who opened it in your guest list.
facts.use_note: Strong fit for overseas guests: link via WhatsApp plus opens tracking on emailed cards. Map snippet shows Joy paper save the dates 'From $1.56 each' (USD, paper product, not digital).

facts.claim: Riley & Grey digital save the dates are sent by email through its Advanced Mode of Guest Management; they look like a typical email with no effects or animation; layout options Text, Upload Image, or Image + Text.
facts.quote: The digital invitations and save-the-dates are sent with our Advanced Mode of Guest Management and sent by email to wedding guests. Therefore, all digital invitations and save-the-dates will look like a typical email and do not have additional effects or animation aspects. However, you have different options for the email layout including the following: "Text," "Upload Image," "Image + Text."
facts.use_note: Help page last updated Oct 2024; may be out of date. Whether Advanced Mode needs a paid plan: see pricing fact.

conflicts.topic: Platform timing for destination save the dates
conflicts.detail: Greenvelope: 8 to 12 months for destination. Evite wedding page: 8 to 12 months generally, earlier for destination. Evite blog snippet: 6 to 8 months. Use our own WW guidance instead.
